name: GetSales
description_en:
GetSales combines cloud sessions, automation, sender rotation and a team inbox. It describes isolated account workspaces, stable regional sessions and account-health monitoring. These are product mechanisms and vendor safety claims, not proof that a third-party platform will allow a particular activity. Its own site says it is independent of LinkedIn and use remains subject to third-party terms.

For a pilot, connect one authorized sender, set its working days and timezone, add a small reviewed audience and build the next steps. Use the team inbox to assign responses and inspect account-health alerts before increasing volume. The page advertises live campaign editing and multiple senders. Validate pause and duplicate behavior yourself; persistent sessions reduce reauthentication work but do not eliminate account restrictions.
description_zh:
GetSales 组合云端会话、自动化、发送端轮换与团队收件箱。它描述独立账户工作区、稳定地区会话与账户健康监测。这些是产品机制及厂商安全主张，不能证明第三方平台一定允许某种活动。官网自己说明产品独立于 LinkedIn，使用仍受第三方条款约束。

试点时可连接一个经授权的发送端，设置工作日与时区，加入少量已审查受众，再构建后续步骤。通过团队收件箱分配回复，增加量之前检查账户健康提醒。页面宣传支持在线编辑活动与多个发送端。暂停及去重行为仍需自行验证；持久会话可减少重新认证工作，但不能消除账户限制。

core_features.explanation_zh: 为每个账户保留独立工作区。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate senders and conversations in shared outreach.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在共享触达中协调发送端与会话。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; not an executed test or customer result.

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: For a pilot, connect one authorized sender, set its working days and timezone, add a small reviewed audience and build the next steps. Use the team inbox to assign responses and inspect account-health alerts before increasing volume. The page advertises live campaign editing and multiple senders. Validate pause and duplicate behavior yourself; persistent sessions reduce reauthentication work but do not eliminate account restrictions.
steps.zh: 试点时可连接一个经授权的发送端，设置工作日与时区，加入少量已审查受众，再构建后续步骤。通过团队收件箱分配回复，增加量之前检查账户健康提醒。页面宣传支持在线编辑活动与多个发送端。暂停及去重行为仍需自行验证；持久会话可减少重新认证工作，但不能消除账户限制。

items.en: Playtables is described prominently on the homepage, but the pricing page labels it COMING SOON and early access. Treat it as unavailable for a required production dependency until access is confirmed. GetSales fits teams coordinating several outreach accounts; a simple personal follow-up may need less infrastructure. The reviewed service is cloud-based, with no verified source license or self-hosting distribution. If a session disconnects, check account state and queued actions before reconnecting and restarting.
items.zh: 首页突出介绍 Playtables，但定价页标注 COMING SOON 与 early access。确认实际可用前，不应把它作为生产必需依赖。GetSales 适合协调多个触达账户的团队，简单个人跟进可能无需这套基础设施。本次服务以云端为主，未确认源代码许可与自托管发行版。会话断开时应先检查账户与排队动作，再重新连接和启动。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The visible pricing view shows Send $39, Enrich $49 and Scale $69 per seat/month, alongside monthly, six-month and twelve-month selectors; verify the selected commitment in checkout. Enrich includes three email inboxes per seat and Scale twenty. LLM, enrichment, email-finding and validation allowances differ. “Unlimited” plays and leads does not make these credits unlimited. Trials are offered, but their duration and a perpetual free tier were not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 可见定价展示 Send 每席位每月 39 美元、Enrich 49、Scale 69，同时有月付、六个月及十二个月选择；应在结算时核对选中的承诺期。Enrich 每席位含三个邮箱，Scale 含二十个。LLM、数据补充、查邮箱与验证额度各不相同。“无限”活动和线索不能解释为这些额度也无限。官网提供试用，但本次未确认期限或长期免费层。
